reason: The plugin is primarily an automation utility that records DSH conversation state and synchronizes it to Tencent IMA notes/knowledge base without adding code-generation, search, or UI features. Evidence in the README shows event-driven turn/session syncing, configurable credential loading, optional local script upload path, and OpenAPI fallback, which places it in automation with external integration and knowledge-management behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，可在会话每轮结束和会话销毁时自动整理对话进度并上传到腾讯IMA的每日笔记或工作知识库，支持按优先级调用本机上传脚本或IMA接口。
summaries.en: This DSH plugin automatically packages conversation progress at turn and session end and uploads it to Tencent IMA daily notes and optional Work knowledge base, with priority for a local upload script and fallback to IMA API calls.

capabilities: Automatically captures and uploads DSH conversation progress on turn and session end
Reads configuration/credentials from profile, environment, and local IMA config files
Invokes a local upload binary when available, with fallback to remote IMA OpenAPI calls
Writes summaries/notes to Tencent IMA daily notes and optional Work knowledge base

reasons.code: README states the plugin listens to turn and session lifecycle events and triggers uploads at turn end and agent disposal.
README documents credential and project/kb config sources including profile config, environment variables, and local ~/.config/ima files.
README describes upload flow that prefers ~/.local/bin/ima-upload and falls back to IMA OpenAPI endpoints (list_note/import_doc/append_doc/add_knowledge).
package.json defines a DSH bundle plugin package with dsh bundle metadata, indicating integration into the DSH runtime.
